$comment: Hand-edit this file only; IA.md and matrix.csv are generated. Route accounting: meta.totalRoutes is the number of distinct URLs in the live sitemap (1583); every template routeCount is the number of those URLs that the clone resolves to that template, and the counts sum to 1583. The 7 client-redirect source URLs (REDIRECTS in src/routes.js) are counted under the template of their destination page and listed in redirectSources. Two routes exist only in the clone route table and have no sitemap equivalent (/product/guides, /glossary); they are listed in cloneOnlyRoutes of two templates with routeCount 0. The sitemap-served-by-clone check passed for all 1583 URLs except /lp/agents-run-your-analytics-full, which still renders the not-found-style stub.

meta.title: MotherDuck clone: information architecture
meta.source: https://motherduck.com/ (live sitemap, 1583 URLs) as reproduced by the React/Vite clone in this repo
meta.generatedBy: Authored with the ia-builder skill from src/routes.js, src/App.jsx, src/pages/** and src/components/**; routes counted by matching sitemap paths against route patterns

categories.SHELL: Chrome that wraps pages: skip link, announcement bar, headers, menus, footers and the alternative navs of sub-apps.
categories.HERO: Page-opening block: headline, lede and primary action, sometimes with art or meta.
categories.FEATURES: Product explanation and capability modules: diagrams, feature cards, comparisons, directories of tools.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer logos, quotes, case-study cards, investors, testimonials.
categories.CONTENT: Substantive reading material and structured information: article bodies, FAQs, tables, transcripts, event and partner details.
categories.EDITORIAL: Feeds and teasers of dated or curated editorial items: posts, news, videos, events, episodes, recommendations.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is to capture a lead, registration, subscription or click-through: forms, CTA bands, gated downloads, registration bars.
categories.COMMERCE: Pricing and cost-model blocks: plans, matrices, calculators.
categories.LEGAL: Legal and policy documents and their navigation.
categories.UTILITY: Navigation and interaction helpers: filters, search, pagination, tables of contents, modals, back links and floating buttons.
categories.APP: A self-contained interactive app surface embedded as a page.

shell.skip-link.description: Visually hidden "skip to main content" anchor, the first focusable element; becomes a visible boxed link pinned to the top-left on focus and targets the main landmark.
shell.skip-link.scope: Rendered by the app root on every route, including the chrome-less and own-nav ones.

shell.announcement-bar.description: Full-width accent strip above the navbar carrying a one-line announcement and an arrow link; on narrow viewports it collapses once the page is scrolled.

shell.site-header.description: Fixed top navigation: wordmark, primary links, dropdown triggers and action buttons, plus a scroll-driven bottom border. Its offset (--header-total) is applied to the page wrapper.
shell.site-header.scope: Carried by every template whose chrome is full or dark (1445 routes); absent on own-nav, lp-only and bare routes.

shell.mega-menus.description: Click-open dropdown panels under the Product, Community and Company nav items; closes on outside click or Escape.
shell.mega-menus.scope: Opened from the site header on all 1445 routes that carry it.

shell.mobile-menu.description: Slide-in navigation panel used below the desktop breakpoint.
shell.mobile-menu.scope: Toggled from the site header on all 1445 routes that carry it.

shell.site-footer.description: Dark footer: wordmark and social glyphs on the left, four link columns, open-source note, legal links and two compliance badge placeholders.
shell.site-footer.scope: Closes every full or dark chrome route (1445 routes); absent on own-nav, lp-only and bare routes.

shell.dive-nav.description: Compact top bar of the Dive Gallery sub-app (replaces the site header).

shell.dive-footer.scope: Used instead of the site footer by the gallery and dive-detail templates, 136 routes in total.

shell.lp-anchor-nav.description: Fixed single-purpose landing-page bar: logo that returns to top, in-page anchor links and one primary call to action. The site header and footer are hidden through a body attribute while this page is mounted.
